spec2def(kdstub.dll kdstub.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# kdstub.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/kdstub-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(kdstub_shims OBJECT kdstub.c)
add_cargo_module(kdstub kdstub-cargo kdstub.dll
    KIND kerneldll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS kdstub_shims psdk)
